summary: Under normal market conditions, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in the securities comprising the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that are involved in the following sub-segments of the global music industry (the “Global Music Industry”): (i) music streaming; (ii) music content and distribution; (iii) live music events/ticketing; and (iv)music equipment and technology. The fund is non-diversified.
